For third-trimester self-monitoring.
map.12 小时肾动数 = (早 + 中 + 晚 各段计数) × 4；≥ 30 正常，: 12-hour fetal movement count = (morning + noon + evening segment counts) x 4; >=30 normal, 20-29 borderline, <20 low
map.采用 Cardiff 计数法：累计三段肾动后拓展至 12 小时估算，超过阈值提示: Uses the Cardiff counting method: accumulate three fetal-movement periods then extend to a 12-hour estimate; exceeding the threshold suggests an intrauterine condition.
map.孕 28 周后孕妇每日数胎动，监测胎儿宫内状态。: After 28 weeks, pregnant women count fetal movement daily to monitor fetal intrauterine status.
map.胎动明显减少时及时就诊。: Seek medical care promptly when fetal movement clearly decreases.
map.高危妊娠（妊高症、FGR）加强监测。: High-risk pregnancy (preeclampsia, FGR) needs closer monitoring.

map.数胎动的标准是什么？: What is the standard for counting fetal movements?
map.常用「2 小时≥10 次」或「12 小时≥30 次」；重点看自身规律变化，较绝对: Commonly '>=10 in 2 hours' or '>=30 in 12 hours'; focus on one's own pattern change, more reliable than absolute value.
map.胎动少一定是缺氧吗？: Does reduced fetal movement always mean hypoxia?
map.不一定，可能与母体活动、血糖、服药有关；但明显减少（降幅 >50%）或持续减弱应: Not necessarily; may relate to maternal activity, blood sugar, medication; but a marked decrease (>50%) or persistent weakening should prompt medical care to rule out distress.
